_meta.rule: Baskets and channel-to-basket hypotheses were fixed before any sector cell was first computed. The event study computes the full channel-by-outcome grid and controls false discovery at 10 percent across it; the hypotheses below say which cells were predicted in advance, so a hit outside them is exploratory, not confirmatory. Changes are append-only with a methodology changelog entry.
_meta.basket_construction: Equal-weight, daily-rebalanced mean of member log returns; outcome is basket return minus Nifty return (strips market beta), cumulative over 1, 5, and 20 trading days after an episode start.

defence.rationale: State defence manufacturers and shipyards: order books and sentiment respond to India's own security posture.

energy_omc.rationale: Oil marketing companies: refining margins and retail pricing are squeezed when crude supply risk rises, the transmission path of Gulf risk.

it_services.rationale: Dollar-revenue exporters: exposed to US demand, visa and trade policy, and the rupee-dollar rate.

ports_logistics.rationale: Port operators and container logistics: cargo volumes and freight rates carry chokepoint and shipping-lane disruption.

gulf_energy.direction: negative after supply-risk episodes (OMC margins squeezed)

shipping.direction: sign not predicted: disruption can cut volumes or raise freight economics; magnitude predicted to exceed other channels
